blurb: Guests can rent canoes and explore waterways and woods from the base camp on Big Lake. The outfitter offers bunkhouse accommodations, canoe rentals, shuttle services, and guidance for first-time canoe trips. Various canoe sizes and equipment rentals are available, with shuttle services to BWCA entry points.
